name: retro-zine-portfolio-dev-server
description: Dev-only server for the real index.html, so Crochet/Sewing's image folders can be glob-imported live (import.meta.glob). Unrelated to react-components/project-detail's own package.json, which builds that component's production bundle — this one just serves the whole static site through Vite so image auto-discovery has a live process to run in. Not required to view the site normally (index.html still opens fine via file://); only needed if you want new Crochet/Sewing photos to appear without a rebuild.
